subject.title: Feature request: aggregate token usage and cost across all providers

question: Which provider data sources and metrics should CodexBar officially treat as additive in a cross-provider total, and should the existing merged Overview selection control inclusion?
rationale: Current main intentionally separates local token-derived estimates from provider-specific spend and budget snapshots, so source compatibility, currency behavior, duplicate-source policy, and setting semantics cannot be selected safely without maintainer intent.

options.title: Normalize conservative contributions
options.body: Aggregate only provider adapters that expose compatible token buckets or same-currency monetary amounts, with provenance, confidence, and exclusions visible.

options.title: Unified comparison without totals
options.body: Show provider rows and time ranges together while omitting grand totals whenever sources, currencies, or units are not safely additive.

options.title: Keep provider-local accounting
options.body: Retain the existing merged provider presentation and local Codex/Claude cost reporting without introducing a universal accounting contract.

recommendation.title: Normalize conservative contributions
recommendation.body: Aggregate only provider adapters that expose compatible token buckets or same-currency monetary amounts, with provenance, confidence, and exclusions visible.

likelyOwner.reason: The accepted provider-presentation design and repeated cost and CLI history make steipete the strongest available owner for this product-level accounting decision.
